description: CLI agents from their vendors' own installers on macOS, found by the paths those write.
why: The installers' macOS branches, which 84-linux-installers runs on Linux. Each path is the only witness for its agent here: nothing installs these through Homebrew on this host, so the catalog's path values, not a cask or formula, are what match. must_contain pins each path, so one agent found another way cannot pass for its path.
known_gaps: Nothing is run after installing, so state that appears on first use is unexamined, as in 84.
